name: Objektas B
notes_for_evaluator: gt_dimensions intentionally empty — per-room data not extracted yet. Totals derived from pasiūlymas 2026-04-13. Largest of the 5 batch projects (65-page TP).

dazymo_walls_plus_ceilings_combined_m2.source: pasiūlymas items 16+17 sum (424.75 + 68.28) — matches Objektas A convention

sienu_molio_tinkas_m2.notes: Clay plaster — not in default formula scope but contractor-billed

doors_atkosai_m.source: pasiūlymas item 19 'Durų angų paruošimas beapvasdinėms durims'

plyteles_sienos_grindys_combined_m2.source: pasiūlymas items 28+30+31 (157.34 + 52.59 + 7.52) — all m² tile-laying lines
plyteles_sienos_grindys_combined_m2.notes: Aggregation of the three per-format tile lines already recorded above (plyteles_sienos_grindys_1200x1200/1200x600/didzformaciai). Excludes linear item 29 (b/m nišos angokraščiai) and item 32 (10.49 m² didžformačių nišos angokraščiai — reveal tiling our room model does not produce).

isliginamasis_grindys_m2.source: pasiūlymas items 39 (Išlyginamojo pylimas 39.43, plytelių skyrius) + 102 (Išlyginamojo sluoksnio įrengimas 143.19, grindų skyrius)
isliginamasis_grindys_m2.notes: Contractor bills floor screed in two trade sections; the engine's isliginamasis_m2_total covers ALL non-concrete floors, so the semantically matching truth is the sum. The original ilyginamasis_grindys_m2 entry (143.19, item 102 only) is kept for provenance but is scope-incomplete for this comparison.

grindjuostes_total_m.notes: Engine emits one combined baseboard total (grindjuosciu_m_total); truth is the sum of both baseboard type lines.

pvc_grindys_m2.notes: Key name follows the engine bucket pvc_grindys_m2_total = non-tile finished floor covering (PVC/parketas/laminatas). This project's covering is parquet; garage rubber mat (item 108, 10.8 m², Papildomi darbai) is out of scope for this bucket.

walls_paint_total_m2.notes: Assumes painted-ceiling area = billed GKP ceiling area (identity holds exactly on Objektas A: GKP 102.78+62.82 = 165.60 = contractor ceiling paint; and here item 17 dažymo virš 3m = 68.28 = GKP virš 3m exactly). Clay-plastered walls (item 18, 160 m²) are billed separately and are NOT in this paint figure.

ceiling_paint_total_m2.source: derived: billed GKP ceilings 74.91 + 68.28 (items 1+2); item 17 (lubų dažymas virš 3m) = 68.28 confirms the convention
